detected_fault: GPU Overclocking or unstable clock speed, Faulty RAM (Corsair Vengeance LPX) with incompatible XMP profiles, Software conflicts (e.g., HWinfo64, MSI Afterburner)
suggested_solution: Try disabling ray tracing and enabling debug mode in the NVIDIA control panel.
Check for updates on Windows and GPU drivers.
Consider rolling back to an older driver version (e.g., 577).
Monitor power plans and adjust settings accordingly.
